versions.changelog:
- Added initial metadata files: .clawhub/origin.json and _meta.json
- 文档升级：现在提供淘宝下拉框/combobox的自动化（evaluate + JS遍历点击DOM，已验证可控），流程说明更完善
- 注意事项与操作步骤更新，明确 JS evaluate 方案适用性，辅助所有需要选项选择的场景
- 其它原有功能、接口说明未改动

Initial release of Taobao product auto-publishing skill.

- Automates the Taobao/Qianniu merchant product publishing workflow, including category selection, image upload, and product info autofill.
- Supports automatic extraction and filling of product information based on user-provided images.
- Handles common fields (title, price, inventory, attributes) and provides references for browser automation actions.
- Notes current automation limitations with dropdowns and image uploading, with suggested workarounds.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and recommended product info templates for quick start.
